title: Motor Overheat
fullDescription:
Miele C3 Complete and Blizzard canisters trip thermal protection when airflow is blocked or the bag/container is full.

Allow 30-45 minutes cooldown before restart.

fixSteps.title: Change bag/empty bin
fixSteps.instruction: Replace GN dust bag or empty bin.

whenToCallPro: If does not restart after cooldown.

title: Power Brush Fault (SEB)
fullDescription: F2 on vacuums with SEB/SEB228 electro brush indicates the powered brush motor stalled or has electrical fault.

fixSteps.title: Check cord
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect brush head cord for damage.

title: Change Bag Indicator
fullDescription:
C3 Complete shows a red change bag indicator when airflow is restricted by a full bag.

Replace with genuine GN HyClean bag.

fixSteps.title: Replace bag
fixSteps.instruction: Open lid, slide out full bag, install new GN.

title: Blizzard Bin Full
fullDescription: Blizzard CX1 bagless models show the empty bin indicator when the dust container reaches Max line.

title: HEPA/Timestrip Expired
shortDescription: HEPA AirClean filter due for replacement.
fullDescription: Miele HEPA filters have a Timestrip indicator that changes color after ~50 hours of use; replace to maintain filtration.

fixSteps.title: Swap HEPA
fixSteps.instruction: Open exhaust flap and install new HA50 filter.

title: Suction Hose Obstruction
shortDescription: Blockage in hose, wand or floor nozzle.
fullDescription: Loss of suction with bag/filter OK usually means an obstruction inside the hose or wand.

fixSteps.title: Detach hose
fixSteps.instruction: Remove hose and inspect both ends.

fixSteps.title: Push through
fixSteps.instruction: Use a broomstick to dislodge blockage.

title: Cord Rewind Jam
fullDescription: Spring-loaded cord reel may fail to retract due to tangle, kinked cord or broken spring.

fixSteps.title: Pull full cord
fixSteps.instruction: Pull cord completely out then feed straight back.

title: SBB Parquet Bristles Worn
shortDescription: Floor tool bristles below wear indicator.
fullDescription: Miele floor tools include a wear indicator; replace bristles or tool when bristles reach the indicator.

fixSteps.title: Replace brush strip
fixSteps.instruction: Swap bristle strip or entire SBB tool.

title: Vacuum Won't Start
fullDescription: No response from power button usually means cord, switch, or capacitor failure on the main board.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug another device to confirm outlet.

fixSteps.title: Service switch
fixSteps.instruction: Have authorized Miele service test switch/board.

faq.a: Typically 7 years on motor, 1 on accessories.

title: Reduced Suction Power
fullDescription: Reduced suction is typically the combined effect of filter, bag, and hose buildup rather than a single code.

fixSteps.title: Full service
fixSteps.instruction: Change bag, HEPA, motor filter and clean hose.

whenToCallPro: Only if service fails to restore suction.
